applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Use the recorded transaction status to determine the local handling.

| Status | Meaning and handling |
|---|---|
| Awaiting credit | Open Submit documents for that payment. Typical evidence includes the platform's account-binding page and its remittance record. |
| Under review | Submitted information is being assessed. Check registered email, including spam, for additional-information requests. |
| Processing (`PENDING`) in sampled review | Submit material against the selected transactions marked Awaiting credit. Approval of those selected transactions releases the associated processing transactions together. |
| Credit failed | Review was unsuccessful and a return is required. |
| Refunded | The return has been completed. |

Review normally takes two business days. If the payment is still under review after one business day, checking for a request for more information is appropriate; that check does not mean the two-day period has already expired.

A secondary operator may not see the affected payment or submission entry. Ask the primary operator to view or handle it. In a restriction tied to pending incoming material, completion of the required review may also restore the affected payout function.

For a customer-requested return, confirm the original-route return instruction. Once initiated, it cannot be cancelled. A failed review cannot be reopened through this same process. Deal with pending incoming payments before closing the affected account.

title: Incoming payments awaiting supporting documents
